preconditions.description: The number of pillars n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The minimum height difference d is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(h) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**15 for x in h)
preconditions.description: The list h contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 10^15 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The integer k equals the number of indices in the output sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in indices) and indices == sorted(indices) and len(set(indices)) == len(indices)
postconditions.description: The output indices are distinct integers between 1 and n, sorted in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(h[indices[i]-1] - h[indices[i+1]-1]) >= d for i in range(len(indices)-1)) if len(indices) > 1 else True
postconditions.description: For every adjacent pair of pillars in the sequence, the absolute difference in their heights is at least d.

postconditions.expression: all(len(seq) <= k for seq in valid_sequences)
postconditions.description: The length k is maximal; no other valid jump sequence has a length greater than k.
